limitations: Candidate groups organize declarations; they do not establish capabilities or runtime reachability.
Operation and domain labels are lexical candidates; inherited routes, dynamic views and dataflow remain unknown.
Literal controller/template and mapper/interface links are lexical references, not executed behavior.
Table tokens and SQL statements remain candidates; no service/table joins are inferred.
Every public source asset is inventoried; no production configuration, database, private material or network is read.
Owned-runtime evidence remains in the seed catalog and never promotes these static records.
